sn1.8:1.1: Ekam antaṃ ṭhitā kho sā devatā Bhagavato santike imaṃ gātham abhāsi || ||
sn1.8:2.1: Yesaṃ dhammā susammuṭṭhā || paravādesu nīyare || suttā te nappabujjhanti || kālo tesaṃ pabujjhitun ti || ||
sn1.8:3.1: Yesaṃ dhammā asammuṭṭhā || paravādesu na nīyare || te sambuddhā sammadaññā || caranti visame saman ti || ||
